Results.ReviewText: I've owned a number of Weber products over the years ranging from the Smokey Joe to the Genesis models, and this most recent purchase is every bit as good as I expected: solidly built and a great performer. I had a few assembly glitches along the way, but Weber's Product Support Associates helped me through them and I'm thoroughly enjoying my new grill.
Results.Title: Best Charcoal Grill on the Market

Results.ReviewText:
The handel is in an awkward position not easy to hang when you remove the cover. 
I have complained with no response.
Results.Title: Handel placement is not right

Results.ReviewText: Great charcoal grill. Well made. You can also purchase great accessories too. Grill does a great job of all your grilling needs. Easy to clean and maintain as well.
Results.Title: Classic Grill

Results.ReviewText: Have used the weber brand grill for over 30 years, don't have any reason to change now.
Results.Title: Oldie but a goodie

Results.ReviewText: I've had Weber Kettles before and they work great for grilling. My only concern with my latest purchase is that the hook under the lid for hanging the lid on the side of the grill is a bit small. It is harder to engage with the edge of the grill than I remember from my older grills. I almost dropped the lid on the concrete patio once when the small hook failed to reach the grill. I'd like to see the hook at least 1/2 inch longer.
Results.Title: Good Grill, Minor Glitch

Results.ReviewText: This is a good grill as the shape makes for even cooking and temperatures for both direct and indirect cooking. It is very simple to use and sturdy enough to last for years. It does have replacement parts which I have also purchased to keep the cooking going.
Results.Title: Consistent Kettle Cooker

Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with this grill it has everything a charcoal bbq needs.  A thumbs up
Results.Title: Good bbq

Results.ReviewText: This is my 4th Weber, and these grills are brilliant w/ their simplicity in form, function, and versatility. Smoking is a breeze and slow cooking is easy to regulate. Updates from older models are welcome features. Thanks to Weber for the veteran discount along w/ free shipping.
Results.Title: Simply The Best

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber kettle. It’s easy to keep at the desired temperature and there’s so much information out there to help me with whatever I’m cooking.  I’ve been using a Weber kettle for 15 years now and won’t get anything else.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: 1 year old, 1 of 3 dampers burnt into, meaning bottom damper is too weak.
Results.Title: Only Weber Weakness

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been a Weber fan for quite a while now. Something about the shape of the kettle and all that just makes for evenness of cooking. This newest one I highly recommend for the durability of the porcelain enamel. Lid to bowl fit and all is just fine. It should last a long time if I take care of it.
Results.Title: Great grill as expected!

Results.ReviewText: Had a lid to bowl fit issue for sometime and decided to reach out even though I had no receipt or could remember when I purchased.
Results.Title: Amazing warranty

Results.ReviewText: Love it, can’t wait for summer grilling!! Replaced my Weber my father gave me with a new one, It still had some like left in it so I gave it to my Neibor . her cheap non Weber grill only lasted a few seasons!!
Results.Title: Webbers last!!

Results.ReviewText: My husband has always loved cooking on a Weber.  Being 'up in his years', I bought him a gas grill, thinking it would be easier for him.  After a few attempts, always ending in a disgruntled griller, I bought him a brand new Weber.  He is a Happy Griller once more.  Gas grill is for sale.
Results.Title: Gas Grill - FOR SALE

Results.ReviewText:
My parents bough this grill in the early 60s. I cooked with it nearly every week. When I bought my first house, this was about 35 years ago, I purchased this to cook my first meal in the house. When I moved, I bought a new grill as I didn't want to move a dirty grill and have owned this one 23 years. It has stayed outside except during hurricanes for all that time. 

I recommend this grill without hesitation. If you have this grill I recommend its use for the Thanksgiving Turkey. It makes cooking the turkey very easy and its taste is superb.
Results.Title: My one and only grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the grill with my American Express points, and can honestly say that it is an amazing beginner grill. I have friends who are pit masters and  they've all recommended this grill as a starter.
Results.Title: My 1st Grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber Customer service is above and beyond. Everything by email, clear conversation and the time management so awesome.
Results.Title: Best Customer Service Ever

Results.ReviewText: Easy set up and use. Large open space to use great for anything
Results.Title: Good simple grill

Results.ReviewText: I’m 67 years old and I don’t remember not having a Weber Kettle. I own a propane grill, a GMC Smoker & both are great, but cooking over briquettes on my Weber is always so enjoyable & I know the meats/vegetables will cook/smoke to perfection. A Weber Kettle is a must for everyone’s outdoor kitchen.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle, a must!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been using a Weber Charcoal Kettle for more than 35 years. I have a gas grill and a flattop which serves me well but I still prefer to do steaks over hardwood lump charcoal.  My last kettle lasted a little over 5 years with almost weekly use and was stored outside on my covered lanai in the Florida heat and humidity.  The Weber Kettle remains a great value and I can’t imagine not having one.
Results.Title: An American Classic

Results.ReviewText: Very simple and easy grilling experience. Unfortunately, the lid hook does not hold the lid at all. I have to place the lid on the ground.
Results.Title: Easy grilling but

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber, and it even more easy to use and the new vent system and simplified ash catch pan stays put better than my old grill. I really like the new simple vent as well , no contact with any hot surfaces, and aid in disposal of spent ashes, works great. Seems to use less charcoal than my first grill. Very satisfied with my Weber!
Results.Title: My second Weber

Results.ReviewText: Good quality grill perfect size for cooking for family and friends
Results.Title: Amazing grill

Results.ReviewText: This thing is awesome! I have never grilled before and this is just the perfect learning grill. If you like to adventure with charcoal and get that nice char, smoky flavor then stop looking and buy this. You wont regret it.
Results.Title: Awesome starting grill

Results.ReviewText: We haven’t really had time to bbq too much but it does what we wanted
Results.Title: Easy bbq

Results.ReviewText: Could use some type of tool holder. Otherwise works as it should
Results.Title: 22" kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: I have purchased at least 5 weber kettle grills over the last 40 years.  They are still the best way to grill.  My only complaint is the quality of the cooking grate seems to have deteriorated.  I currently have 2 grills (1 less than 12 mos, the other about 4 years)  Both have rusted cooking grates
Results.Title: Still the best!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber grill. It cooks like a dream. It does great on ribs.
Results.Title: My 4th Kettle

Results.ReviewText:
This was a replacement for a Weber kettle that was used pretty hard for about 35 years. 
My first grill had the grates replaced about three times in 35 years. I had to braise the lid handle back on about 20 years ago. 
But that grill served my well for 35 years and my new grill is just a modernized replacement. 
Wood handles are gone, they are now plastic. 
It’s the best $150 you’ll ever spend. 
These grill are versatile. You can cook direct, indirect, smoked, and with a spit kit great rotisserie cooking. I couldn’t be happier.
Results.Title: Staying true to form

Results.ReviewText: Works great, just like all Weber products. For steaks I think I’m getting better results having the lid slid off onto the metal handle bracket just a bit. Lid off, the fire doesn’t cook evenly, lid on with bottom and top vents open the fire gets too low. But once I switched to Weber years ago, I’ve never looked back!
Results.Title: Excellent purchase!

Results.ReviewText: I picked this classic because it works and can be used as a smoker also. Quality control still seems to exist at Weber, which we al know is not the case at most other companies. Please reward your entry level employees for cranking out heaters.
Results.Title: Classic backyard grillin

Results.ReviewText: Great grill!! Been using my dads grill that I "inherited". It has to be at least 50 years old. Over time has shown its age. The bottom metal vents one by one began to fall off, then the front handle, then the back one. I finally broke down & bought this one. Weber grills are definitely worth the investment...timeless quality.
Results.Title: Weber kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: My acquisition of the 22" kettle marks a 30+ year love affair and is my 4th over those years. Of course I've added gas grills, pellet grills and even built a smoker. As far as the best charcoal grill the Weber 22" kettle is and will be the only charcoal grill I will ever buy due to the quality and versatility.
Results.Title: Your still the one....

Results.ReviewText: Grill is wonderful. Can be used to grill and smoke meats depending upon on how you use the charcoal. Favor improves the more it is used.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great to use and think of grilling in the back yard growing up. Goes along with my 18" weber bought in 2007
Results.Title: The best grill

Results.ReviewText: This Kettle is amazing! Great size for my family of 3. Built outstanding. Heavy duty. It’s just a awesome grill.
Results.Title: 22” Weber Kettle

Photos.Caption: Doubled up. My 6 year olds grill. he wants to learn.

Results.ReviewText: I've been buying Webers for years. I say that but I've only ever had to buy 1 replacement in 20 years. What a fantastic setup. I also enjoy all the accessories.
Results.Title: 20 year vet

Results.ReviewText: Great product so far. Recently bought this which replaced a similar Weber kettle that was well over 20 years old. Looking forward to at least 20 more years with this kettle.
Results.Title: Great product, easy to use.

ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: For the price there should be thermometer on the lid.  Now I have to drill a hole to get a temp reading.  Basic grilling but guess the extra hole and the thermometer was to much to ask.  If my husband wasn't a die hard for Webers I would have gone a different route.
Results.Title: Going on the cheap when the MSRP is over 250

Results.ReviewText:
This is our 2nd Weber kettle charcoal grill, our last one was at least 15 years old and it was still kicking. We ended up replacing it mostly because the lid had been dented over the years and no longer fit well (we live in Upstate NY and use it year round even in a couple feet of snow). I saw one on sale and figured we could use another. The old one will probably end up at camp. It’s a great grill. I do prefer the chimney to light the coals, but none of us get the newspaper anymore so I have to buy packing paper or start it the old fashioned way and let the fluid smell burn off
Either way you light it, it’s a great grill!!!
Results.Title: Built to last! Charcoal Kettle Griis the way to go

Results.ReviewText: The Weber kettle is versatile, you can grill, smoke, sear all on the same grill. Very reliable and built to last.
Results.Title: The last grill you’ll need to buy

Results.ReviewText: The badest grill out there!  I own 2 the original and the premium. Thee best and American made, you cant go wrong.
Results.Title: Weber owns all

Results.ReviewText: This grill is exactly what my dad was looking for, so it made for a great birthday gift!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful products and family experiences!  We used it for the first time onChristmas Day.  We all had wonderful time grilling together. The steaks and fish were so flavorful!
Results.Title: You Gotta Get One

Results.ReviewText: Pound for pound you can’t beat the Weber 22 inch kettle grill. I’ve been cooking on Weber charcoal grills for 4 decades. They’re the best.
Results.Title: You can’t beat the 22 inch Weber charcoal grill.

741001.Name: Original Kettle Charcoal Grill 22"
741001.Description: Stay true to the modern version of the kettle that started it all—the Original Kettle®, invented by Weber’s founder, and loved around the world. Its ultra-durable, porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, while the dampers easily adjust for precise temperature control. With a One-Touch™ cleaning system for easy cleanup after a long day of grilling, the Original Kettle® will always be the grill built for everyone.•	 Holds up to 13 burgers made with a Weber burger press•	 One-Touch™ cleaning system provides hassle-free ash cleanup•	 Porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, and won’t rust or peel•	 Use the lid hook to avoid placing the lid on the ground while grilling•	 Dampers allow you to easily control the temperature inside your grill•	 Durable plated steel cooking grate retains heat and is easy to clean
